positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: A continuation of a career at BD, handling reports and technical work

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: As a staff engineer, it is my job to lead the team in technical development, provide mentorship, remove obstacles and help the team be efficient, and provide people management.  While at this position, I have led 5 team members and managed 3.  I have interfaced with Manufacturing, Management, Analysts, and product owners.  I define process for my team to ensure best practices are followed, and am responsible to provide the most stable and capable firmware required for the project.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a senior software engineer, it is my job to support the team and provide support to the development of our application software.  Specifically, I was responsible for development of new automation algorithms, and interfaces to hardware not yet enabled in the system.  In addition to assisting to create new algorithms and tests, I helped guide other team members through best practices and troubleshooting, and eventually assisting the technical lead in directing the team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
WGS is a provider of premier RF sensing solutions.

As a software engineer,  responsibilities included updating the current Linux server and Windows UI to customer specification.  As a systems engineer/Product Engineer, managing the project to maintain productivity, schedule, and requirements were primary.  Ensuring the demands of the customer were met, and architecture for the complete solution were common responsibilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Requirements Gathering · Test Procedures · Debugging · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Network Architecture · Embedded Devices · Communication · Product Requirements · Communication Protocols · Technical Documentation · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Automation · FreeRTOS · Firmware · SQL · Software Integration · Data Transfer · Motion Control · Product Demonstration · Programming

positions.title: Engineering Director
positions.description:
Akua is a secure logistics company currently specializing in secure tracking devices and back office reporting solutions.

The Engineering Director ensures the devices and solutions are created on time and to specification.  The Product Engineering team develops new solutions as well as improves on existing hardware and software, and supports deployments of systems worldwide.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
CyberPoint is a cyber security firm with product, domestic, and foreign divisions.  The Baltimore based company prides itself with the innovation and capabilities of its employees.

As a product engineer at Cyberpoint, the main responsibilities ranged from production and support through design and implementation.  Primarily, skills in software development and maintenance were  important.  However, knowledge of embedded hardware, networking, operating systems, documentation, and every aspect of the product life cycle were important.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
QRC is a cellular signal measurement company.  Their main product, DCode, is used to measure cellular ID, channel, and power from cell towers across all bands and technologies.

Main responsibilities were to develop the DCode product.  I was personally responsible for creating the ICS-mobile product, a Windows Mobile cell phone based DCode implementation.  Heavy C# software development, deployment, and maintenance were required.  Some embedded work including design and implementation of embedded software were also required.  Heavy knowledge of Cellular was a must.
positions.insights: Skills: Requirements Gathering · Test Procedures · Debugging · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Embedded Devices · Communication · Product Requirements · Cellular Communications · Communication Protocols · Technical Documentation · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Windows Mobile · Software Integration · Data Transfer · Product Demonstration · Programming

positions.title: Electronics Engineer
positions.description:
Knorr Brake Corp. sells brakes for passenger trains deployed or built in North America.  Their parent company, Knorr Bremse, is located in Munich, Germany, and has facilities across the world.

Responsibilities included every aspect of the product life cycle.  From proposal to support, the Electronic Engineers have the best understanding of the train brake system.  This position primarily centered on Vehicle wiring schematic, embedded hardware design, embedded software design, system engineering, testing, commissioning, and support.  All aspects of the project were documented through CAD, Office, and source code comments.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Architectural testing is a fenestration product testing company.  They test Windows, Doors, siding, and curtain walls for compliance to local regulations.

Responsibilities included maintenance and update of test chambers and facilities.  Design and implementation of test measurement and control systems.  Refrigeration and psychometric control as well as linear displacement, velocity, and sound measurement knowledge were important to provide software and hardware control systems for chambers.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Raytheon systems company is a world leader in Radar technology.

Responsibilities of this position were software development and system development.  Work revolved around the development of a multiface ground based radar scheduler and simulation.
